title: Agent: end-to-end test of the removal notice through a hub with a client lacking AppDataUpdate
description: Follow-up of mimid-4lp4.4. Event::RemovedWithoutAppDataUpdate and the JMAP notice are tested at unit level only (users_of/removed_events, journal round trip, notice key and text); mimi-mls tests the removal itself (didwebvh_mls_rs.rs). An agent-level test needs a client without AppDataUpdate in a hub room: the agent cannot invite one (its Add Commit carries a participant_list AppDataUpdate, which OpenMLS refuses with such a leaf in the group, docs/didwebvh-mls-rs.md), so it needs a plain-OpenMLS or mls-rs client added outside the agent, e.g. by a raw Commit through Room/update, then a did_webvh record change by an agent device (revocation or a new device in the log).
close_reason: test in 4540b5e on branch tests-notice-flaky: crates/mimid-agent-jmap/tests/removal_notice.rs (plain OpenMLS client joined by external Commit via JMAP, revocation by a mimid agent, one notice across a crash replay and restart, hub keeps erin listed).
